name: Phobos Anomaly
description: Sector 66 contains the teleport destination. Lean proves that no sector-adjacency walk reaches it from start sector 9. At the ordinary start, activating any of the 333 linedefs leaves the exit flag clear. In an initially mover-free world every sequence of crossing callbacks leaves that world unchanged. Full gameplay reachability remains open.

proofs.title: Why is the finale disconnected from the start?
proofs.code:
theorem parsedFinale (m : Doom.Map) (loaded : Map.load group "E1M8" = .ok m) :
    site m 0 = some (1, -128, -224, 9) ∧ site m 105 = some (14, 608, 6464, 66) ∧
    ¬ SectorWalk m 9 66 ∧
    ∀ (w : SectorLights.World), w.map = m → w.movers = #[] →
       ∀ events, crosses w events = .ok w := by
  rw [map_loaded] at loaded
  cases loaded
  exact ⟨sitesAndTriggers.1, sitesAndTriggers.2.1, sectorWalkCannotReachFinale, everyCrossingSequence⟩

proofs.title: Can any of the 333 Use targets exit from the initial state?
proofs.code:
theorem parsedInitialUseTargets (s : Simulation)
    (started : (Map.load group "E1M8").bind (fun m => Simulation.spawn m true 1) = .ok s) :
    s.map.lines.size = 333 ∧ ∀ i : Fin 333, (activateImported s i.val).exitRequested = false := by
  rw [loaded_spawn] at started
  cases started
  exact ⟨by decide +kernel, everyInitialUseTarget⟩

proofs.title: What does contact with the finale floor do?
proofs.code:
theorem sectorElevenContact (s : Simulation) (k : Nat) (sec : Sector)
    (atSector : s.map.sectorAt s.player.body.x s.player.body.y = .ok k)
    (atIndex : s.map.sectors[k]! = sec) (code : sec.special = 11) :
    (sectorContact s).map (fun t => (t.exitRequested, t.inventory.health, t.secrets)) =
      .ok (s.exitRequested, s.inventory.health, s.secrets) := by
  unfold sectorContact
  change ((do
    let i ← s.map.sectorAt s.player.body.x s.player.body.y
    let sector := s.map.sectors[i]!
    let (tag, count) := LevelSpecials.secret sector.special s.player.body.z (Fixed.ofInt sector.floor) s.secrets
    pure ({ s with secrets := count, map := { s.map with sectors := s.map.sectors.set! i {sector with special := tag} } } : Simulation)
    ) : Except String Simulation).map _ = _
  rw [atSector]
  simp [bind, Except.bind, Except.map, atIndex, code, LevelSpecials.secret] <;> rfl

name: Blue Atrium
description: The player crosses an empty atrium, collects a blue card, waits for the gate and reaches the first exit on input 87. All earlier prefixes preserve 100 health and all 50 starting bullets.

proofs.title: Cross the atrium and press the exit
proofs.code:
theorem fullPassage :
    ∃ start finish : Simulation,
      Simulation.spawn atriumMap true 1 = .ok start ∧
      atriumInputs.length = 87 ∧
      (∀ k ∈ atriumInputs, ordinaryCombatInput k = true ∧
        keyDown k 8192 = false ∧ keyDown k 1024 = false) ∧
      Passage start atriumInputs finish ∧
      peaceful finish = true ∧ finish.exitRequested = true ∧
      finish.exitSwitchSound = true ∧ finish.ticks = 87 := by
  refine ⟨state0, state87, spawn, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · decide +kernel
  · have allowed : atriumInputs.all (fun k =>
        ordinaryCombatInput k && !keyDown k 8192 && !keyDown k 1024) = true := by decide +kernel
    intro k hk
    have h := List.all_eq_true.mp allowed k hk
    simpa [Bool.and_assoc] using h
  · doom_kernel_exact prefix87
  · decide +kernel
